mapper.select: SELECT * FROM follow_up_rule WHERE organization_id = #{org} AND member_id = #{member}
SELECT * FROM follow_up_rule WHERE organization_id = #{org} AND member_id = #{member} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO follow_up_rule (organization_id, member_id, enabled, inactive_days, run_hour, max_customers, auto_analyze, reminder_minutes, updated_at) VALUES (#{org}, #{member}, #{input.enabled}, #{input.inactiveDays}, #{input.runHour}, #{input.maxCustomers}, #{input.autoAnalyze}, #{input.reminderMinutes}, #{now}) ON CONFLICT (organization_id, member_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.update: UPDATE follow_up_rule SET enabled = #{input.enabled}, inactive_days = #{input.inactiveDays}, run_hour = #{input.runHour}, max_customers = #{input.maxCustomers}, auto_analyze = #{input.autoAnalyze}, reminder_minutes = #{input.reminderMinutes}, updated_at = #{now}, version = version + 1 WHERE organization_id = #{org} AND member_id = #{member} AND version = #{input.version}
mapper.select: SELECT m.organization_id, m.id AS member_id, u.id AS user_id, u.email, u.display_name, o.name AS organization_name, m.role FROM organization_member m JOIN app_user u ON u.id = m.user_id JOIN organization o ON o.id = m.organization_id WHERE m.organization_id = #{org} AND m.id = #{member} AND m.status = 'ACTIVE' AND u.status = 'ACTIVE' AND o.status = 'ACTIVE' AND m.role IN ('OWNER', 'ADMIN', 'MANAGER', 'SALES')

SELECT r.* FROM follow_up_rule r JOIN organization o ON o.id = r.organization_id AND o.status = 'ACTIVE' JOIN organization_member m ON m.organization_id = r.organization_id AND m.id = r.member_id AND m.status = 'ACTIVE' JOIN app_user u ON u.id = m.user_id AND u.status = 'ACTIVE' WHERE r.enabled AND r.run_hour <= #{hour} AND m.role IN ('OWNER', 'ADMIN', 'MANAGER', 'SALES') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM follow_up_automation_run b WHERE b.organization_id = r.organization_id AND b.rule_id = r.id AND b.business_date = #{day}) ORDER BY r.updated_at, r.id LIMIT 50
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO follow_up_automation_run (id, organization_id, rule_id, member_id, business_date, status, created_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{rule.organizationId}, #{rule.id}, #{rule.memberId}, #{day}, 'QUEUED', #{now}) ON CONFLICT (organization_id, rule_id, business_date) DO NOTHING

INSERT INTO follow_up (organization_id, customer_id, owner_member_id, origin, status, due_at, priority, score_version, reason, recommended_action_type, recommended_action, automation_run_id, created_at, updated_at) SELECT c.organization_id, c.id, #{rule.memberId}, 'RULE', 'OPEN', CAST(#{now} AS timestamptz) + interval '1 hour', CASE WHEN c.attributes->>'score' ~ '^[0-9]{1,3}$' THEN LEAST(100, (c.attributes->>'score')::integer) ELSE 60 END, 'proactive-rule-v1', CASE WHEN c.next_follow_up_at <= #{now} THEN '客户计划跟进时间已到' ELSE '客户已连续 ' || CAST(#{rule.inactiveDays} AS text) || ' 天未联系' END, 'OTHER', jsonb_build_object('title', COALESCE(NULLIF(btrim(c.attributes->>'nextAction'), ''), '联系客户，确认下一步安排'), 'source', 'AUTOMATION'), #{id}, #{now}, #{now} FROM customer c WHERE c.organization_id = #{rule.organizationId} AND c.owner_member_id = #{rule.memberId} AND c.deleted_at IS NULL AND c.status = 'ACTIVE' AND c.stage NOT IN ('WON', 'LOST') AND (c.next_follow_up_at <= #{now} OR COALESCE(c.last_interaction_at, c.created_at) <= #{cutoff}) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM follow_up f WHERE f.organization_id = c.organization_id AND f.customer_id = c.id AND (f.status IN ('OPEN', 'IN_PROGRESS', 'SNOOZED') OR GREATEST(f.created_at, f.completed_at) > #{cutoff})) ORDER BY c.next_follow_up_at ASC NULLS LAST, CASE WHEN c.attributes->>'score' ~ '^[0-9]{1,3}$' THEN LEAST(100, (c.attributes->>'score')::integer) ELSE 60 END DESC, c.id LIMIT #{rule.maxCustomers} ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT f.customer_id FROM follow_up f JOIN customer c ON c.organization_id = f.organization_id AND c.id = f.customer_id JOIN follow_up_automation_run b ON b.organization_id = f.organization_id AND b.id = f.automation_run_id WHERE f.organization_id = #{org} AND f.automation_run_id = #{id} AND f.owner_member_id = b.member_id AND f.status IN ('OPEN', 'IN_PROGRESS', 'SNOOZED') AND c.deleted_at IS NULL AND c.status = 'ACTIVE' AND c.owner_member_id = b.member_id AND c.stage NOT IN ('WON', 'LOST') ORDER BY f.id
mapper.update: UPDATE follow_up_automation_run SET created_count = #{count}, status = #{status}, completed_at = CASE WHEN #{status} = 'COMPLETED' THEN CAST(#{now} AS timestamptz) ELSE NULL END WHERE organization_id = #{org} AND id = #{id} AND status = 'QUEUED'
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM follow_up_automation_run WHERE organization_id = #{org} AND member_id = #{member} AND business_date = #{day}
SELECT * FROM follow_up_automation_run WHERE organization_id = #{org} AND member_id = #{member} ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM follow_up_automation_run WHERE status = 'QUEUED' ORDER BY created_at, id LIMIT 2
mapper.update: UPDATE follow_up_automation_run SET status = 'RUNNING', started_at = #{now} WHERE organization_id = #{org} AND id = #{id} AND status = 'QUEUED'

UPDATE follow_up_automation_run SET status = #{status}, agent_run_id = #{agentRunId}, error_message = #{error}, completed_at = #{now} WHERE organization_id = #{org} AND id = #{id} AND status = 'RUNNING'
UPDATE follow_up_automation_run SET status = 'FAILED', error_message = '后台任务中断，请核对 Agent 运行记录后处理。', completed_at = #{now} WHERE status = 'RUNNING' AND started_at < #{cutoff}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO follow_up_reminder (organization_id, follow_up_id, member_id, kind, scheduled_for, created_at) SELECT f.organization_id, f.id, f.owner_member_id, CASE WHEN f.due_at <= #{now} THEN 'OVERDUE' ELSE 'DUE_SOON' END, f.due_at, #{now} FROM follow_up f JOIN customer c ON c.organization_id = f.organization_id AND c.id = f.customer_id AND c.deleted_at IS NULL AND c.status = 'ACTIVE' JOIN organization o ON o.id = f.organization_id AND o.status = 'ACTIVE' JOIN organization_member m ON m.organization_id = f.organization_id AND m.id = f.owner_member_id AND m.status = 'ACTIVE' LEFT JOIN follow_up_rule r ON r.organization_id = f.organization_id AND r.member_id = f.owner_member_id WHERE f.status IN ('OPEN', 'IN_PROGRESS', 'SNOOZED') AND f.due_at <= CAST(#{now} AS timestamptz) + make_interval(mins => COALESCE(r.reminder_minutes, 30)) AND f.organization_id = #{org} AND f.owner_member_id = #{member} ON CONFLICT (organization_id, follow_up_id, member_id, kind, scheduled_for) DO NOTHING
mapper.sql: FROM follow_up_reminder n JOIN follow_up f ON f.organization_id = n.organization_id AND f.id = n.follow_up_id JOIN customer c ON c.organization_id = f.organization_id AND c.id = f.customer_id WHERE n.organization_id = #{org} AND n.member_id = #{member} AND n.read_at IS NULL AND f.owner_member_id = n.member_id AND n.scheduled_for = f.due_at AND f.status IN ('OPEN', 'IN_PROGRESS', 'SNOOZED') AND c.deleted_at IS NULL AND c.status = 'ACTIVE' AND ((n.kind = 'OVERDUE' AND f.due_at <= #{now}) OR (n.kind = 'DUE_SOON' AND f.due_at > #{now}))
mapper.select: SELECT n.id, f.id AS follow_up_id, c.name AS customer_name, COALESCE(f.recommended_action->>'title', '跟进客户') AS title, n.kind, f.due_at, n.created_at ORDER BY f.due_at, n.created_at DESC, n.id LIMIT 10
mapper.update: UPDATE follow_up_reminder SET read_at = #{now} WHERE organization_id = #{org} AND member_id = #{member} AND read_at IS NULL AND id = #{id}
